policies.description: Any update_change request must include the mandatory field `change_id`.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: If the `status` field is supplied, its value must be one of the allowed change request statuses.
When `assigned_to` is provided, the referenced user must have `users.active = true`.
references: User Status: Ensure any user being assigned to (assigned_to) or updated is users.active = true.

policies.description: Only users with the Manager or Administrator role may change a Change Request status that involves approval (e.g., moving to `authorize`).
references: | Agent (agent) | Cannot bypass approvals, or change system administration settings. |

policies.description: If the calling user’s role does not grant authority for the requested update_change operation, the system must return a 403 Forbidden error.
references: 403 Forbidden: Permission denied (user role lacks authority for the operation).

policies.description: The update_change call must be performed as a single validated operation; no additional actions may be combined with it.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.

policies.description: Only users with the **Manager** or **Administrator** role may update a Change Request’s `status` to any value beyond the initial `new` state (e.g., `assess`, `authorize`, `scheduled`, `implement`, `review`, `closed`, `canceled`). Agents are prohibited from bypassing approvals by changing the status to these values.
references: | **Manager** (manager) | Supervision, Escalation, Approvals | Can approve/reject Change Requests. |
| **Agent** (agent) | Frontline Incident/Request fulfillment | Cannot bypass approvals, or change system administration settings. |
